relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Calcitonin gene-related peptide, Pituitary adenylate cyclase-activating polypeptide (PACAP), NOD-like receptor Protein (NLRP3), Serotonin, and some other neuroinflammatory biomarkers are collectively responsible for the cerebral blood vessel dilation and involved in the nociceptive pain which leads to migraine attack.
